description: This file defines hooks for a Vue component testing setup using Playwright. It imports lifecycle hooks, a router, a Button component, and styles, and defines `beforeMount` and `afterMount` hooks to configure the app with routing and components before and after mounting.

methods.name: beforeMount
methods.description: A hook executed before mounting the Vue app, configuring routing and registering Button component.

methods.name: afterMount
methods.description: A hook executed after mounting, logging the DOM element's class name.
